newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Hermis Bank maintains rise on Lithuania bourse.
newsitem.headline: Hermis Bank maintains rise on Lithuania bourse.

text.p: Hermis Bank maintained its recent rise, helping to lift the official list index of the Lithuanian bourse on Thursday, dealers said.
Market volume remained low with 416,000 litas traded on the central market and just over a million litas' worth of shares swapping hands in block trades.
The official list index, which tracks the market's top five stocks, rose 8.98 points to 922.6. The wider group A index dipped 1.87 points to 1870.89.
Hermis Bank advanced to 200 litas from 198.2 on turnover of 70,000 litas on the central market.
"Hermis still dominates the market and the demand for its shares is satisfied only partially at the moment," Saulius Merkys, a broker with Vilfima brokerage, told Reuters.
Dealers say its price has been pushed up by the successful distribution of a 23 million litas share issue. The bank also reported on Wednesday that its first half profit was 14.3 million litas.
Dealers say the market is now waiting for rival Vilniaus Bank's results. It remained stable in very light trade of 1,200 litas.
Another official list company, Rokishkis Cheese, rose to 41.98 litas from 41 litas on turnover of 63,000 litas.
